allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Atal Realtech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of  1,19,81,250 Equity Shares, 45,00,000 warrants convertible into Equity Shares out of which 9,00,000 warrants were converted into equity shares upon receipt of the remaining 75% of the issue price of said warrants pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on October 10, 2025

allot.subject: Preferential issue
allot.text: Atal Realtech Limited has informed the Exchange about Preferential issue
